title: [Bug 500351] Allow Effective Permissions for delegated admins and helpdesk
summary: The Effective Permissions page now works for delegated admins and helpdesk users in SaaS instead of blocking them, since the underlying platform crash that prompted the original guard has been fixed.
key_points: Skips the Entra ID check in the Effective Permissions page for users with the Delegated Admin or Helpdesk plan
Delegated users have an empty Authentication Object ID, so before this fix the page always blocked them
The platform crash that originally required the guard has been fixed
Non-delegated users without an Entra ID account still get the error
Adds tests for delegated admin, delegated helpdesk and non-delegated user cases
